supported_context_single_chip.basis: Phase 1 of the design: single-chip functional layers with the sparse DSA path validated up to 16385 tokens (tests/test_dsa_long.py::test_sparse_16k, layer 3 vs HF: prefill PCC 0.99906, last 2048 rows 0.99982, decode at 16385/16386 0.99996/0.99995). The advertised 1 048 576 positions are the Phase 2 multi-chip (8x4) contract with the user-partitioned paged latent cache.
supported_context_single_chip.hard_limit_note: Not a hard physical limit of one chip for a single user (11 latent caches at 1 M positions = ~11 GB bf16 + 32 B/token pooled keys fit the 32 GB DRAM next to one layer's weights); the single-chip bound is validation time of the v1 composite paths, not capacity.

largest_tested.prefill_evidence: sparse path: 16385 (PCC 0.99906), 4097 on a random prompt (0.9998) and on the repeated prompt (0.99977); dense path: 2040 (0.99988, permuted page table, slot 1), 256 (layers 0/3/4: 0.99984 / 0.99992 / 0.99997), 1000 (DSA 0.99961, KDA 0.99995), 200 non-aligned (0.99980 / 0.99993), 1-token user (0.9968)
largest_tested.decode_evidence: sparse decode at 16385/16386 (0.99996/0.99995), 4097..4108 on a random prompt (>= 0.9997, selection 98-99 % of HF ids, pool cache 0.99999 vs host), dense->sparse 2040..2063 (>= 0.99962), dense 256..259 / 1000..1002, traced replay == eager, 8 users (worst 0.99936)

cache_and_position_semantics.kda_state: per user: recurrent [1,64,128,128] fp32 + conv history [1,3,24576] bf16, written by prefill into fixed user slots of a persistent [max_batch,...] state; decode updates all slots in place (trace-safe)
cache_and_position_semantics.dsa_latent_cache: paged [max_blocks,1,32,512] bf16 per layer; page table [max_batch, blocks_per_seq] with any unique block mapping (tested: identity and random permutations); prefill fills a user's pages from position 0, decode appends at the user's position
cache_and_position_semantics.dsa_index_cache: pooled keys [max_batch*pool_blocks,1,32,128] bf16 (one row per 4 tokens, identity table) + per-user 32-row raw k/gate rings (row = position % 4); maintained on every prefill and decode call, dense or sparse
cache_and_position_semantics.positions: DecodePositions: persistent [B] int32 device tensors (position, position // 4, position % 4) plus the host values; refreshed in place per step (trace-replay safe); the host values select the sparse path
cache_and_position_semantics.mode_switch: DSA layers: dense exact attention while every user's position < 2048, indexer + top-2048 + tail beyond (HF selects all visible tokens through position 2050; the switch at 2048 is exact there too); tested across the boundary at 2040..2063
cache_and_position_semantics.batch: fixed user slots: decode batch == max_batch; tested max_batch 1, 2 and 8 (prompt lengths 1..200, permuted page table)
cache_and_position_semantics.traced_decode: capturable for every layer kind; refused for DSA decoders whose max_seq_len > 2048 unless allow_sparse_range (dense attention past 2047 is not HF semantics); the sparse decode runs eagerly from host positions
